column5: Oracle/pool over-mint on external-integration deposit -- ### Summary `Vault.sol:deposit()` mints shares off a trusted external `oracle.getPrice()` and an external `IPool(pool).deposit(assets, true)` return, so a manipulated price or imbalanced pool over-mints shares against the depositor invariant. ### Root Cause In `Vault.sol` deposit trusts external-protocol return values with no bound or validation. ### Impact Over-minted shares drain vault value -- a direct loss of user funds.
